card.name: Words inside political and historical speeches
card.fires_on: Ordinary words such as I, to, future, or working inside quoted political or historical statements about government, labor, or policy. It appears in archival-style web text, not drug labels.

modes.label: Resolutions and labor politics
modes.description: The word to after verbs like enact or opposed in resolutions and labor rhetoric.

card.plain: It lights up on everyday words in old political speeches and quoted resolutions, not on medical text.
